review_notes: I read the whole target file and the related FractionRingAlgebraicIndependence.lean. I also checked Mathlib's `IsFractionRing.map` definition and searched Mathlib and the project for an existing lemma saying `IsFractionRing.map` sends `algebraMap a` to `algebraMap (j a)`. I found none, which is why I report a missing canonical simp lemma. The file has no @[simp] declarations, so there are no competing rules or loops to report. I could not run Lean, so I did not check how the proposed simp lemma would interact with other rules, and I did not test any replacement proof. The same `hrename` block appears twice in the target and once in the sibling file.

findings.problem: There is no canonical simp lemma for `IsFractionRing.map hj (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap B L (j a)`. Every use therefore unfolds the definition `IsFractionRing.map` with `simp only [IsFractionRing.map, IsLocalization.map_eq, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]`. The same unfolding recipe appears in `isFractionRing_adjoin_fractionRing_map_rename_compl` (lines 134-140), in `algebraicIndependent_fractionRing_map_rename_compl` (FractionRingAlgebraicIndependence.lean, lines 92-93), and again in the project's Tests and TypeTests files. The recipe depends on the definition of `IsFractionRing.map` and on the `AlgHom`-to-`RingHom` coercion lemmas, so it is brittle. It also forces each proof to rewrite `hmap` first and then unfold.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma, for example `IsFractionRing.map_algebraMap {j : A →+* B} (hj : Function.Injective j) (a : A) : IsFractionRing.map (K := K) (L := L) hj (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap B L (j a) := IsLocalization.map_eq _ _`. Mathlib's `IsFractionRing.map` has no such lemma. Mark it `@[simp]`; this is safe because the left side is a ring-hom application to an `algebraMap` term and the right side is a smaller normal form. Add a corollary `algebraMap_algebraMap_of_map_eq` with the hypothesis `hmap : algebraMap L K = IsFractionRing.map ...` that proves `algebraMap L K (algebraMap A L p) = algebraMap B K (j p)`. Then `hrename` becomes `by rw [hmap]; simp` at both sites. Put the corollary in FractionRingAlgebraicIndependence.lean or a shared file so all three sites reuse it.
findings.benefit: The three duplicated, definition-unfolding simp calls collapse into one simp-normal rewrite rule. Proofs about these fraction-ring maps then no longer depend on the internals of `IsFractionRing.map` and `AlgHom.toRingHom`. The simp set gains a canonical way to evaluate `IsFractionRing.map` on image elements, so downstream users can use `simp` instead of copying the unfolding list.
